news.title: Covington man charged after wife found shot at McDonald’s drive-thru
news.summary: Deputies responded to the restaurant about 1 a.m. Oct. 17 and found Davienne Trejo, 26, of Lakeland, Florida, wounded.

news.title: Student dead, another wounded in shooting at Atlanta Technical College
news.summary: Atlanta police responded around 8:45 a.m. on Oct. 19 to a report of a person shot at 1560 Metropolitan Parkway SW.

news.title: Coweta County ATV crash: 8-year-old killed on Pate Road in Newnan
news.summary: An 8-year-old child died Monday following an ATV crash along Pate Road in Coweta County.

news.title: Neighbor describes tense moments as SWAT searched for murder suspect: ‘They weren’t playing’
news.summary: Gwinnett authorities captured two people linked to a deadly Norcross shooting; one suspect is still missing.

news.title: Student dies after allegedly shooting another student at Atlanta college
news.summary: One student died and another was hospitalized following a shooting Monday morning at Atlanta Technical College, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Man shot outside Buford Highway lounge, police say
news.summary: A man was shot in the arm early Monday morning outside Nollywood, a lounge on Buford Highway.

news.title: Trial delayed for APD officer charged with assault in Midtown bar fight
news.summary: Atlanta police officer Garrett Rolfe is the same officer who shot and killed Rayshard Brooks in 2020. Rolfe is accused of simple assault after a fight at X Midtown.

news.title: Atlanta educator killed in Six Flags fall to be remembered
news.summary: Family and friends will gather Monday afternoon to remember Atlanta educator Hassan Karim, who died after falling from the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.

news.title: 13-year-old shot again at southeast Atlanta apartment complex
news.summary: A 13-year-old boy is recovering after gunshots rang out and struck his home early Sunday morning in southeast Atlanta.
